content.tagline: Exosomes made in-house — from raw material to finished product
content.descriptor: A Korean biotech company from Yongin: its own exosomes, the EXOLUNA brand — scalp care, a clinic set and activators for aesthetic salons
about: RNH BIO is a Korean biotechnology company based in Yongin, Gyeonggi Province. Its speciality is exosomes: the company produces them with its own Multi RN-Exosome technology and works in two roles at once. It owns the EXOLUNA brand of finished products and at the same time supplies the exosomes themselves as a raw material to those who develop formulations.

The exosomes come from two origins. The plant ones are obtained by upcycling — from material that would otherwise be waste: Japanese hop, coffee fruit, camellia fruit, peppermint, rice, five species of seaweed. Milk exosomes stand apart. The combinations differ from product to product, each chosen for its own task.

There are three product directions. EXOLUNA is the retail scalp care line. EXOLUNA RX PRO is a set for clinics. LUNA RN-Exosome Activator is a range of activators for aesthetic salons, in two tiers, basic and premium. One thing is common to all: the exosomes are supplied freeze-dried and activated immediately before use.
facts: Finished products and raw material alike
channels: Brands and contract manufacturers — as a raw material supplier

lines.name: EXOLUNA Scalp Booster
lines.note: The retail scalp care line. A 60 ml ampoule and a freeze-dried activator, mixed before use. The company states a complex of four plant exosomes — Japanese hop, coffee fruit, camellia fruit and peppermint — together with biotin, amino acids and the functional ingredients MELTANE and caffeine. Use once a day in the evening.

lines.name: EXOLUNA RX PRO
lines.note: A clinic set of two vials: 2 g of freeze-dried exosomes and a 2 ml activating ampoule. A dual exosome system — milk and camellia fruit. The company positions it for use immediately after procedures, including MTS and laser. Stated purposes: recovery, tone, firmness.

lines.name: LUNA RN-Exosome Activator · Professional Basic Line
lines.note: Two activators for salons. Brightening & Firming — milk and camellia exosomes, working on tone and firmness. Scalp Booster — Japanese hop and coffee exosomes, working on scalp and hair.

lines.name: LUNA RN-Exosome Activator · High-End Special Line
lines.note: Four EXONOVA activators for specific tasks. PDRN Repair on five-seaweed exosomes. White Glow on rice and milk exosomes. EGF Firming on camellia and coffee exosomes. Noggin Scalp on Japanese hop, coffee, peppermint and camellia exosomes.

tech.name: Multi RN-Exosome
tech.note: The company's own technology. Exosomes are obtained from plant material by upcycling and from milk, and they go into finished products as complexes of several types rather than one at a time.

tech.name: Freeze-dried plus activator
tech.note: The exosomes are supplied dried in a vial, the activating ampoule comes separately, and the two are mixed immediately before use. The format was chosen for stability: once prepared, such a system does not keep for long. For a buyer that means specific storage requirements and staff training.

tech.name: The company's own test data
tech.note: The company presents laboratory results: cell viability by CCK8, antioxidant activity by DPPH, inhibition of melanogenesis, and dermatological before-and-after tests. These are the company's data from laboratory models, not clinical trials of the finished product on people.

tech.name: MoCRA registration
tech.note: For the EXOLUNA line the company states a completed registration under the US MoCRA regime. A registration confirms that the market-access procedure has been carried out; it is not a confirmation of efficacy.

content.exportNote: The company is open to Latin American and North American markets. It is ready to discuss both finished products and the supply of exosomes as a raw material for third-party formulations.

ui.products_note: Three concentrated ampoules in the Drop series: tone and pigmentation, barrier and renewal, hydration and soothing. Each carries one key active at a stated concentration. Price on request.
ui.terms_disc: Prices and terms are indicative and are finalised at the deal stage through Teranova. Direct supplier contacts are not published: Teranova Group runs the negotiation, the checks and the delivery.
ui.cta_d: Get in touch — Teranova arranges the negotiation, the checks and the whole deal from first contact to delivery.
ui.certs_note: The 0.00 mark is the skin irritation index from testing by the Korea Institute of Dermatological Sciences on the three Drop products: a twenty-four-hour closed patch test, November 2025. Everything else is as stated by the company; documents are provided to the buyer on request.
